name: walkingpad
title: WalkingPad
description: Control the KingSmith WalkingPad P1 from Raycast — start, stop, set speed, view today and session history.
author: jkrumm

commands.name: controller
commands.title: Controller
commands.description: Live status and full controls (recommended hotkey: ⌥W)

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: WalkingPad
commands.description: Live speed and today's totals in the menu bar

commands.name: speed-up
commands.title: Speed Up
commands.description: Increase belt speed by the Speed Step (default 0.5 km/h). Bind a global hotkey in Raycast settings — recommended ⌥=

commands.name: speed-down
commands.title: Speed Down
commands.description: Decrease belt speed by the Speed Step (default 0.5 km/h). Bind a global hotkey in Raycast settings — recommended ⌥-

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Start or Stop
commands.description: Toggle the belt: running → Stop, idle → Start at the Default Start Speed. Bind a global hotkey in Raycast settings — recommended ⌥*

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Daemon URL
preferences.description: Where the WalkingPad daemon HTTP API is listening

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Bearer token for the daemon. Leave empty when running on loopback with auth disabled.

preferences.name: speedStep
preferences.title: Speed Step
preferences.description: km/h increment for Speed Up / Speed Down actions

preferences.name: defaultStartSpeed
preferences.title: Default Start Speed
preferences.description: km/h used when the menu-bar Start button or the Start/Stop toggle command starts the belt without a chosen speed. Range 0.5 – 6.0.
